Private catamaran or yacht

Charter the whole boat just for your group and sail the Puerto Plata coast. Choose from 4 catamarans and 2 yachts.

Boats leave from Sosúa beach, 45 minutes from Amber Cove port and 30 minutes from Taíno Bay. You can add round-trip transport from the port: its price, by group size, is below.

Price for the whole boat, not per person: only your group on board, for 4 hours. Snorkeling is included on every boat.

Subject to availability: before paying, message us on WhatsApp or by email to confirm the boat is free on your date.

How booking a boat works

  1. Choose the boat and the date, and send us your booking on WhatsApp or by email with your ship’s name and all-aboard time.
  2. You book with a deposit; each boat’s amount is in its details.
  3. Boats leave from Sosúa beach, 45 minutes from Amber Cove and 30 from Taíno Bay. Add round-trip transport from the port if you like: it’s priced by group size.
  4. We schedule the 4-hour trip around your ship’s times so you’re back on time.

Boat charter questions

For the whole boat. Unlike shared boat trips, which are sold per person, you charter the boat just for your group for 4 hours. The price covers up to 15 or 20 people, depending on the boat, and each additional person pays extra. Each boat’s price is in its details.

From Sosúa beach, about 45 minutes from Amber Cove port and 30 minutes from Taíno Bay. Round-trip transport from the port is optional: add it in the booking form; it’s priced by group size (see the table with the boats).

Choose the boat, fill in the booking form and send it to us on WhatsApp or by email: we write it up for you, ready to send. You book with a deposit; each boat’s amount is in its details. Tell us your ship’s name and all-aboard time.

Yes. Since the boat is just for your group, it’s a great way to celebrate: bachelorette parties, birthdays, small weddings or a family day. On the Libreterre we can help with decorations, cake, catering, photos and video (on request).

We plan every tour around your ship’s departure time. When you book, tell us your ship’s name and your all-aboard time.

Cancel 10 or more days before your tour and we refund 100% of what you paid; with less than 10 days’ notice, we refund 50%. If your cruise ship doesn’t reach Puerto Plata, we refund 90%.
